extracted.intended_audience: NLP / ML researchers and practitioners working on creative plot generation, language-model alignment, and narrative modelling
extracted.subtask_description: Generating high-quality, premise-conditioned creative plots using small language models (<=5B parameters) via structured, preference-based alignment and evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transform concise premise into a coherent narrative
rubrics_metrics.description: The system must transform a concise premise into a coherent narrative that sustains global structure, character development, and emotional resonance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on turning a short premise into a full plot; ensure coherence across events and scenes so the story reads as a unified narrative rather than a sequence of disconnected beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Global structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Sustain an overarching plot structure across the generated narrative (global structure).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain a consistent plot arc and logical progression of events from beginning through resolution; avoid local coherence at expense of overall arc.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character development
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrate meaningful character development throughout the plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Characters should evolve or reveal depth over the course of the plot (arcs, motivations, consequences), not remain static or purely functional.

rubrics_metrics.name: Emotional resonance
rubrics_metrics.description: Evoke emotional impact and maintain emotional throughlines across the narrative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Craft plot beats and character interactions that generate affective response; ensure emotional continuity and payoff across major events.

rubrics_metrics.name: Premise-conditioning / faithfulness to prompt
rubrics_metrics.description: Generate plots that are conditioned on and faithful to the provided concise premise (premise-conditioned plots).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expand and elaborate the premise without contradicting or losing its core elements; preserve the premise's intent while adding coherent detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Narrative Quality Dimensions (NQDs) — Aspect Rating Reward Model
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver structured narratives across five Narrative Quality Dimensions (NQDs) using an Aspect Rating Reward Model trained via a Positive-Negative prompting strategy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Train a reward model that rates multiple narrative aspects (the paper references five NQDs) using positive/negative prompting examples; use these aspect ratings to guide generation toward balanced, multi-faceted quality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preference alignment via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
rubrics_metrics.description: Align a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) plot generator to human preferences using Direct Preference Optimization on high-confidence preference pairs.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collect or identify high-confidence preference pairs and use DPO to directly optimize the generator toward preferred outputs; this is the mechanism for embedding human-like judgments into generation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agentic Evaluation emulating human critical judgment
rubrics_metrics.description: Post-hoc evaluation should emulate human critical judgment via an Agentic Evaluation module to provide unbiased assessment of generated plots.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use an automated evaluation agent designed to mimic human critics to assess outputs after generation, enabling systematic, unbiased comparison across models and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sensitivity to narrative quality (discriminative evaluation)
rubrics_metrics.description: The framework should be sensitive to narrative quality differences and reliably distinguish plots derived from critically acclaimed versus widely panned screenplays.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation protocols should test the system's ability to rank or separate high-quality and low-quality plots (e.g., by comparing outputs conditioned on acclaimed vs. panned source material).

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource-efficiency and small-model competitiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Enable Small Language Models (<=5B active parameters) to produce high-quality plots competitive with frontier systems up to 200x larger.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design training, alignment, and architecture choices (e.g., MoE, reward modeling, DPO) to achieve strong performance under tight capacity constraints; measure competitiveness versus much larger LLM baselines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Structured, preference-based alignment as a methodological desideratum
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopt structured, preference-based alignment (combining aspect reward models, preference optimization, and agentic evaluation) as an effective, resource-efficient approach for creative plot generation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Integrate multiple components (aspect rating, DPO alignment, and agentic evaluation) to produce and assess plots in a way that reflects human preferences while remaining computationally tractable.
